title.narrative: Sustainability of enterprises strengthened with focus on entrepreneurship development, access to finance, market systems development and the social and solidarity economy

description.narrative: The multiple crisis in Lebanon has severely affected enterprises in Lebanon, leading to a large decrease in private sector activities resulting in a large drop in both GDP and tax revenues, and a decrease of employment by 23% in 2020 in key sectors of the formal economy, and by almost half in micro-enterprises which hire the majority of poor and vulnerable people. Businesses across sectors face the consequences of the severe devaluation and numerous structural challenges that put high pressures on them severely hampering their productivity and competitiveness and disrupting markets and supply chains. Against this backdrop, supporting livelihoods and alleviating the direct negative impact of the crisis on vulnerable populations is the key focus for ILO support to sustainable enterprises, for a productive and export-oriented economy that would create productive and decent employment and contribute to structural change and enabling environment. An important component of this support is building capacities for fostering economic, social, and environmental sustainability of enterprises, supporting government, social partners, productivity institutions and other actors involved in the private sector support to contribute positively to that process. This will be done, while continuing to adopt market systems development approaches that focus on inclusivity and productivity, as well as providing developing successful models of interventions in terms of entrepreneurship training delivery multi-dimensional business development support and enhanced access to financial services. Specific focus will be also put on strengthening and expanding successful social and solidarity economy models. This is in line with the UNSDCF Outcome 1 on Prosperity which has as objectives to “boost productive sectors” and to” improve the business environment” to generate new, equal and inclusive income opportunities.
